Americans favor slowing AI development, polls and studies suggest

A majority of Americans desire a slowdown in the development of artificial intelligence, rather than a complete halt, according to a CBS News poll. Concurrently, a separate study indicates that concerns about job losses due to AI now surpass optimism about new job creation. These findings reflect a global sentiment of uncertainty regarding AI's impact on the workforce.
